title: Student Transportation Services: Address Changes, Enrollment Changes and the End of Service
content:
**Rule.** A reported change of residence of a Student Transportation Services rider is re-evaluated within the re-evaluation days of the timetable (5 calendar days) from the routing system's new measured distance and hazardous zone.

- **Address no longer qualifies.** When the new address no longer meets the type's eligibility basis, service continues for the grace days of the timetable (10 calendar days) after the re-evaluation date, the re-evaluation date being day 0, and then ends, closed for an address change. The family may apply under a type the new address meets.
- **Enrollment type changes.** When the student's enrollment type changes to one that no longer keeps district transportation eligibility, service ends the day before the new type takes effect, closed for an enrollment change.
- **Permanent housing.** A McKinney-Vento School-of-Origin Transportation assignment continues to the end of the school year after the family obtains permanent housing.
- **Other endings.** A district withdrawal ends service on the withdrawal date. A semester permit ends after its semester, closed at the end of its permit period. Every assignment ends at the end of the school year, a new application being needed for the next school year.

## Grace period, both sides (hypothetical dates)

| Re-evaluation date (day 0) | Last day service continues | First day without service |
|---|---|---|
| a Monday, the 3rd of a month | the 13th | the 14th |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- **Enrollment type takes effect on the 1st of a month.** The last day of service is the last day of the month before.
- **A McKinney-Vento rider's family moves into permanent housing in February.** Service continues to the end of the school year.
- **A rider withdraws from the district on a Thursday.** Service ends that Thursday.
